caption: We Europeans are very proud of our civilization, whose fundamental values are the defense of freedom and human dignity—exactly the opposite of the values that drive the Trump administration. @secrubio
text: Department of State & @StateDept “WE DO NOT WANT ALLIES TO BE SHACKLED BY GUILT AND SHAME. We want allies who are proud of their culture, and their heritage — who understand that we are heirs to the same great and noble civilization, and who together with us are willing and able to defend it.” -SECRETARY RUBIO = U.S. DEPARTMENT of STATE
